description:
Use list_access to read people (email, name, invited/active), restricted/anyone link access, the stable copyable link, what viewers see and Marketplace state. invite and remove_viewer manage view-only people; set_access changes restricted/anyone access; reset explicitly invalidates the old link; preview opens the normal account or strategy page with viewer data only. Reading/copying never rotates a link. There are no sharing passwords or payment requirements. Existing create/revoke remain compatible.

Set "action" to choose the operation. Only send the fields listed for that action.

## action="create": Create or rotate a private account or strategy link
Required fields: publicationId.
Issues a high-entropy bearer link for one explicit publication. Reopening returns the same link; only an explicit rotation changes it. Anyone with the link can forward it; use private_share_link(action="revoke") to invalidate it. Links use the secret URL and stored access permissions, never an extra password. New links have no extra password. Expiry, revocation and named-recipient permissions still apply.

## action="revoke": Revoke a private account or strategy link
Required fields: publicationId.
Immediately invalidates the bearer link for exactly one owner publication.

## action="list_access": List people and link access
Required fields: publicationId.
Owner-only sharing, using the same service as the website. People are viewers, never traders. Restricted access requires an invited sign-in; anyone access permits forwarding the secret link. Account viewers use a free sign-in, never checkout. Copying or reading access never changes a link. Only reset changes it and immediately invalidates the old link. No sharing password exists. An invite saves access without sending an email. Active means the email has a registered account; invited means it can register later. Responses include the people list, link access and stable URL, permitted performance/positions/filled trades, Marketplace listing state and the canonical viewer preview URL.

## action="invite": Invite people to view
Required fields: publicationId, emails.

## action="remove_viewer": Remove a viewer
Required fields: publicationId, email.

## action="set_access": Set restricted or anyone link access
Required fields: publicationId, linkAccess.

## action="reset": Reset the sharing link
Required fields: publicationId.

## action="preview": Preview the normal page as a viewer
Required fields: publicationId.

action.description: Which operation to run: "create", "revoke", "list_access", "invite", "remove_viewer", "set_access", "reset", "preview". See the tool description for each one.

email.description: Used with action="remove_viewer". Required for action="remove_viewer".

emails.description: Used with action="invite". Required for action="invite".

expiresAt.description: Optional ISO-8601 expiration. Must be in the future. Used with action="create".

linkAccess.description: Used with action="set_access". Required for action="set_access".

publicationId.description: Used with action="create", action="revoke", action="list_access", action="invite", action="remove_viewer", action="set_access", action="reset", action="preview". Required for action="create", action="revoke", action="list_access", action="invite", action="remove_viewer", action="set_access", action="reset", action="preview".

recipientEmail.description: Restrict access to one authenticated existing BotSpot user. Used with action="create".

rotate.description: Invalidate the prior token and issue a new one. Used with action="create".

name: private_share_link
title: Share accounts and strategies with people or a link
